maria-docs: Heads-up - I spotted a mismatch in the API ref for POST /v1/rerank. The request example uses `queries: ["q1", "q2"]` but the SDK snippets expect `queries: [{text: "q1"}, {text: "q2"}]`. Also the response example shows scores sorted ascending, while runtime returns descending. Can someone help align examples + snippet?

sam-runtime: yep saw that during a canary. Runtime accepts both array-of-strings and array-of-objects for historical reasons, but the canonical shape should be objects with `text` and optional `metadata`. We should update the example and call out the backward-compatible string shorthand.

jay-sdk: Agree. The JS/Go snippets currently construct `{ queries: texts }` and assume strings. I can do a tiny SDK patch to normalize strings -> objects, but docs should show the preferred shape.

maria-docs: Proposed text change: "Request: `queries: Array<{text: string, metadata?: Record<string,string>}>`. Backcompat: `Array<string>` is accepted and will be normalized." Also update the response sample to show scores descending (highest first) and include `query_id` echo.

liz-qa: Can we add a small example for batching? Folks confuse `batch_size` with grouping multiple queries in the same request. Maybe a short note: "To batch multiple queries in one rerank call, include them in the `queries` array; do not use `batch_size` which controls internal worker batching."

jay-sdk: I'll add a helper in the JS snippet: `normalizeQueries(qs){ return qs.map(q => typeof q === 'string' ? {text:q} : q) }` and update example usage in docs.

maria-docs: Great. I'm about to open a docs PR. Draft change list: update request schema, add string-shorthand note, fix response ordering, add small batching note, update JS snippet to include helper. Linking PR in thread when ready.

sam-runtime: Also please add a test vector in the runtime test harness that checks the response order is descending, so future docs won't drift. I'll create a tiny test ticket: https://issues.redwood.ai/RT-1287

maria-docs: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 - includes examples + updated OpenAPI example blocks. Please review.

jay-sdk: Reviewing now. Quick suggestion: in the snippet show both input forms, e.g.:
// preferred
{ "queries": [{ "text": "How to tune my model?" }, { "text": "Best quant for LLMs" }] }
// shorthand accepted
{ "queries": ["How to tune my model?", "Best quant for LLMs"] }

maria-docs: Added that. Also added a short migration note for users who relied on ascending-sorted `scores` - change: "scores are returned highest-first; if you relied on ascending order, invert or sort accordingly."

liz-qa: Quick QA: please include one integration example where `queries` include `metadata: {user_id: 'abc'}` so customers see how to pass context.

maria-docs: Done. I pushed another commit to the PR.

deploy-bot: deploy status: docs-staging build queued (job #7899). See https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/7899

jay-sdk: LGTM from me after one minor wording nit.

sam-runtime: I added RT-1287 test and will add to the canary suite.

maria-docs: Thanks all - will merge after CI and one more review. If anyone fears breaking changes, note that runtime normalization preserves string shorthand, so no customer breaking behavior. :thumbsup:
